title: Find the Italian names of all black Artifact cards that are legal in the Co
question: Find the Italian names of all black Artifact cards that are legal in the Commander format and have unknown power (either null or '*'), illustrated by artists who also created at least one full-art card.

prediction.sql:
SELECT fd.XCL_079
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'black'
  AND c.XCL_070 = 'Artifact'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')
  AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (SELECT c2.XCL_002 FROM cards c2 WHERE c2.XCL_018 LIKE '%fullart%')
